column1: # The PVC test of the CARTRIDGE CRC screen limited to the PVC games (src/c0/crc.s, docs/DECISIONS.md §20 pt 13), on 2026-10-31.
# MAME 0.286, -bios euro, -video none, -sound none, -nothrottle, non-merged romsets of $ROMS. No ROM word is kept here.
# SOURCE READ: MAME 0.286 src/mame/neogeo/neogeo.cpp, comments above each ROM_START: ID-0268 mslug5, ID-0269 svc, ID-0271 kof2003.
# RUN 1, THE CATALOGUE: a lua probe at frame 200 compares the word at $108 with these three numbers. 166 sets tried, 164 ran: yes
# on the three below, no on the 161 others. 2 files of the folder are not MAME sets (not run).
# RUN 2, THE SCREEN: the crc-* scenes on image 95d481bc…; the writes of the 68000 at $200000-$2FFFFF through a write tap (J_ECRITS
# of son.lua), from the opening of the screen to the frame of the last reading.
# RUN 3, THE PRICE: the three PVC games with $108 reading 0999 through bench/crc-ngh.lua, scenes crc-hack-*, image 95d481bc…, each
# against a witness with the game's own number. The bank line is MAME's; no game has been tried with a real changed header.
# retour: the menu, the TEST screen, then the game 900 frames after the hand-over, its picture equal to the witness's.
# kof2003's three writes: $0000, $0001, $0000 (frames 788, 1261, 1289). Leaving out the final write of bank 0 changes no verdict of
# crc-hack-kof2003 (mutation tried, it survived, not kept): the game returns all the same, so this scene does not prove that write.
# ASSUMED: a real cartridge carries the same number at $108, and flash carts do nothing else on this screen. Not tried on hardware.
